product_offering.core_offering: Highnote provides an API-first embedded finance platform that enables businesses to launch card programs, process payments, and access financial infrastructure without building it from scratch. The platform unifies card issuing (debit, prepaid, credit, and commercial travel cards), merchant acquiring, instant payments, stablecoin settlement, and agentic commerce capabilities into a single system. Customers can deploy programs in weeks rather than quarters.
product_offering.differentiator: API-first unified platform combining issuing, controls, ledger, and reconciliation in a single system; Agentic Commerce capabilities built with Visa for AI-initiated payments; fastest time-to-market with programs launching in weeks rather than quarters; support for both traditional and stablecoin payment rails.
product_offering.functional_benefit: Enables businesses to launch virtual card programs, real-time payments, and merchant acquiring without building infrastructure from scratch; programmable spend controls and approval structures; tokenized credentials and dynamic authorization for secure transactions; real-time visibility and reconciliation.
product_offering.problem_solved: Businesses lack the infrastructure to launch card programs, process payments, and enable modern payment capabilities like AI-initiated transactions and stablecoin settlement without building everything from scratch.
quantifiable_outcome: Customers can launch card programs in weeks rather than quarters
Billions in annual acquiring volume commitments from enterprise partners like Netevia
product_offering.product_overview: Highnote is a unified embedded finance platform that provides a comprehensive suite of financial infrastructure services. The core platform includes Digital Debit and Prepaid Card Issuing and Credit Card Issuance capabilities, complemented by U.S. Merchant Acquiring for payment acceptance, Instant Payments for real-time money movement, and Stablecoin Settlement for blockchain-based enterprise payments. The platform also offers Agentic Commerce for AI-initiated payments and specialized Commercial Card Issuing for online travel. These products integrate issuing, controls, ledger, and reconciliation into a single system, allowing customers to launch programs in weeks rather than quarters.

recent_move.description: Raised approximately $125 million Series B led by Adams Street Partners and Omega Venture Partners (later extended by an additional $25 million), bringing total disclosed funding to roughly $210+ million.

Launched Agentic Commerce capabilities built with Visa Intelligent Commerce, enabling AI agents to initiate and execute payments with programmable controls, tokenized credentials, and dynamic authorization — a first-of-kind commercial offering in this category.
Signed a 6-year expanded agreement with Netevia committing billions in annual acquiring volume, anchoring the U.S. Merchant Acquiring launch with a flagship enterprise customer.

Brought stablecoin settlement into production with Cross River Bank as part of Visa's stablecoin settlement pilot, enabling USDC settlement over the Solana blockchain with near-instant funds movement and seven-day settlement availability for enterprise payment flows.
Launched U.S. Merchant Acquiring service with full pay-in and pay-out functionalities integrated with major card networks, vertically extending the platform beyond issuing into payment acceptance.

Launched 24/7 stablecoin funding with BVNK alongside Instant Payments supporting real-time money movement via major payment networks, adding a parallel crypto-funded rail to the instant payments offering.

expansion_highlight.description: Launch of stablecoin settlement with USDC on Solana (Dec 2025) and 24/7 stablecoin funding with BVNK (Feb 2026) signals expansion into blockchain-native payment rails, opening the platform to crypto-native enterprise customers and cross-border treasury use cases.

Agentic Commerce launch with Visa (May 2026) establishes a new product vertical targeting AI-driven businesses and financial operations teams, addressing AI-initiated purchasing, invoice automation, and vendor payments — a category that did not commercially exist prior to this launch.

Commercial Card Issuing purpose-built for online travel agencies, marketplaces, and travel platforms (Apr 2026) indicates a focused vertical-specialization strategy, following evidence that both major card networks have highlighted Highnote's role in modern travel payments in earnings calls.

Flagship partnerships with Visa (Agentic Commerce, stablecoin pilot), Cross River Bank (stablecoin settlement), and BVNK (stablecoin funding) collectively constitute an ecosystem buildout that expands Highnote's distribution surface and rails without requiring proprietary build of each layer.

U.S. Merchant Acquiring launch (Jan 2025) extends the platform from card issuance (a sell-side capability) into payment acceptance (a buy-side capability), opening the full payment value chain to customers and significantly expanding revenue surface per customer.

$125 million Series B (Jan 2025, extended by $25M) led by Adams Street Partners provides explicit funding signal supporting continued platform expansion, headcount scaling, and product investment across issuing, acquiring, instant payments, and stablecoin.
